Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AMZN.
We delivered record revenue of $8.8 billion this quarter, representing 8% year-over-year growth.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 8% to 16% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2022.
We generated $18.3 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $8.8 billion this quarter, representing 8% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
